$comment: Setup presets (SPEC §8.1): which capabilities the enrollment checklist pre-ticks. Every capability of the host's catalog is offered; the ones listed under a preset are ticked. 'mcp' lists the MCP risks ticked for every configured server (capability mcp:<server>:<risk>:*). Capabilities never ticked by any preset (messages:send, automations:manage, devices:control, secrets:read, host:admin, skills:write) are still offered, unticked: a person grants them on purpose.

observer.label: Observer: reads and researches; asks before changing anything

assistant.label: Personal assistant (recommended): works in its workspace and memory; asks before commands, sending, deleting and paying

builder.label: Builder: also runs commands, code and sub-agents and drives a browser; still asks before sending, deleting and paying
